definition: The umbrella task of identifying what an image contains — classification, detection, and recognition collectively.
details: The umbrella task of identifying what an image contains — classification, detection, and recognition collectively.

explainer.lead: Image recognition is the umbrella task of identifying what an image contains, covering classification, detection and recognition. It matters as the broad label for turning image data into decisions.

tiers.eli5: Like looking at a picture and saying what is in it, where it is, and what it is called.
tiers.practitioner: Engineers treat recognition as a family of tasks and pick the right one per problem; a common pitfall is conflating classification with detection when the task needs localisation.
tiers.paperLevel: The umbrella task of identifying what an image contains — classification, detection, and recognition collectively.
